svg.title: Session OTEL live update
svg.text: Session OTEL tab — live update (FR-10, FR-10a)

A new OTEL portion arrives (hook ships every ~5 s; the tab polls with a since= cursor and gets only the delta). The delta is merged in place; exactly what is new or changed is highlighted for ~1.5 s, then fades.
Before — t₀ (Agent expanded, one span selected, Bash and WebFetch collapsed)
After — t₀ + 5 s: delta merged in place
What the owner asked for — in place, not a redraw
Changed KPIs: amber outline + delta chip (+$0.23, +3); unchanged KPIs stay still.
Chart: only the newest bucket grows; the added segment is outlined; other bars do not re-animate.
Ancestors whose rolled-up Σ cost changed get a brief outline on the value only.
New spans slide in under their parent: amber background, left bar, NEW tag. Existing rows keep their DOM
(keyed by span_id); expand / collapse state and the selected span stay as they were.
No scroll jump: new rows below the visible area are announced by a pill; click scrolls to them.
Highlight lifetime: appears on merge, holds ~1.5 s, fades out by ~2 s. Reclassification (hidden ↔ visible after a transcript arrives) is not marked as new.
no requests; one catch-up delta on return
Stop received / no data — polling stops
old hook: data at turn end / 60 s — upgrade
